ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly low-intensity (dark) base across both lobes. High-intensity (white) pixel distribution is mapping to linear streaks in the medial regions and high-density circular mottling in the lower image-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical U-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with moderate frequency serration; the image-right lobe displays sharper pixel-amplitude peaks compared to the image-left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The image-left lobe trailing edge follows a slightly concave curve; the image-right lobe exhibits a convex sweep ending in a recurved, hook-like tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast circular white pixel groups located on the lower and trailing portions of the image-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned high-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks), including a distinct intersecting 'X' pattern on the image-left lobe and parallel oblique lines on the image-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-directional rake marks across both lobes and significant localized depigmentation clusters suggestive of prior parasitic or physical impact.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct, continuous high-intensity arc-shaped linear mark on the upper-outer quadrant of the image-right lobe.
